footnote_text: On October 26, 2026, the Reporting Person was granted 100,000 additional restricted stock units under the Issuer's 2020 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan, as amended, in recognition of service on the Board of Directors, which vested in full on the date of the grant. Each restricted stock unit represents the right to receive one share of common stock.

Represents shares of common stock issued under the Issuer's 2020 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan, as amended, pursuant to a Settlement Agreement and Release effective October 26, 2026, in full satisfaction of $94,790.77 of accrued and unpaid director fees for the period from April 2024 to January 2025. The number of shares equals $94,790.77 divided by $5.55, the consolidated closing bid price of the common stock on The Nasdaq Stock Market on October 26, 2026, rounded down to the nearest whole share.
